title: The Derge Kangyur in Tibetan: the Vinaya's first volume, the Perfection of Wisdom, the sūtra volumes of the Lalitavistara, the Laṅkāvatāra, the Lotus, the Sukhāvatīvyūha and the Vimalakīrti, and the catalogue
edition: The Digital Derge Kangyur of the Esukhia–Barom proofreading project (2014–2018), from the UVA–SOAS 2013 eKangyur, after the Derge woodblock edition held by the Library of Congress (BDRC W4CZ5369): Esukhia/derge-kangyur at commit a582cf471b7c85a101035071078032f106a8e536 (archived; continued as OpenPecha P000001). Eight of its 103 volumes.

list.work: Derge Kangyur, volume 1: Vinaya ('dul ba), volume ka: the Vinayavastu begins (Toh 1)
Derge Kangyur, volume 33: Prajñāpāramitā (brgyad stong pa): the Aṣṭasāhasrikā (Toh 12)
Derge Kangyur, volume 34: Prajñāpāramitā, various (shes rab sna tshogs): the Diamond (Toh 16) and the Heart (Toh 21) among the shorter sūtras
Derge Kangyur, volume 46: Sūtra (mdo sde), volume kha: the Lalitavistara (Toh 95)
Derge Kangyur, volume 49: Sūtra (mdo sde), volume ca: the Laṅkāvatāra (Toh 107)
Derge Kangyur, volume 51: Sūtra (mdo sde), volume ja: the White Lotus of the True Dharma (Toh 113) and the Sukhāvatīvyūha (Toh 115)
Derge Kangyur, volume 60: Sūtra (mdo sde), volume ma: the Teaching of Vimalakīrti (Toh 176)
Derge Kangyur, volume 103: The catalogue of the Derge Kangyur (dkar chag)

normalization: The volumes as the repository serves them under original/; text/ the same text under ASCII names, line endings normalized. The repository's markup is kept: [1a] and [1b.1] for folio and line, {D…} for the Tohoku number at the head of each text.
scope: Eight volumes, chosen so that the Mahāyāna sūtras seated in Sanskrit (29/09) and in Chinese (29/10) stand also in Tibetan, with the Vinaya's opening and the catalogue by which the rest is found. The other 95 volumes are queued.
